dishes.name: Steamed Minced Pork Patty
dishes.description: A classic home-style steamed pork patty.
steps: Peel and finely chop the water chestnuts.
Mix the pork with the water chestnuts, light soy sauce and potato starch, and stir until sticky.
Spread flat on a plate and steam over high heat for 12 minutes.

dishes.name: Steamed Pork Ribs with Black Bean Sauce
steps: Rinse the pork ribs and drain well.
Marinate with the fermented black beans, minced garlic, light soy sauce and potato starch for 15 minutes.
Steam over high heat for 15 minutes.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Beef with Ginger and Spring Onion
steps: Marinate the beef with light soy sauce and potato starch for 10 minutes.
Heat the oil and fry the sliced ginger until fragrant.
Add the beef and stir-fry over high heat until about 70% cooked, then add the spring onion sections and toss well.

dishes.name: White Cut Chicken
steps: Bring a large pot of water to the boil with the ginger and spring onion.
Put the chicken in, turn off the heat and let it poach for 30 minutes.
Remove, plunge into cold water, then chop into pieces and plate.

dishes.name: Steamed Chicken with Shiitake Mushrooms
steps: Soak the dried shiitake mushrooms until soft, then slice into strips.
Cut the chicken into pieces and marinate with the seasonings for 15 minutes.
Top the chicken with the mushrooms and shredded ginger, and steam over high heat for 15 minutes.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Pork with Green Pepper and Tomato
steps: Marinate the pork with light soy sauce for 5 minutes.
Cut the green peppers and tomatoes into chunks.
Fry the garlic until fragrant, add the pork and stir-fry until it changes colour, then add the peppers and tomatoes and toss well.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Chicken with Broccoli
steps: Cut the broccoli into small florets and blanch for 1 minute.
Marinate the chicken for 5 minutes, then stir-fry until cooked.
Add the broccoli and toss well.

dishes.name: Steamed Hairy Gourd with Minced Pork
steps: Peel the hairy gourd and cut into thick slices.
Season the minced pork and spread it over the gourd slices.
Steam for 12 minutes.

dishes.name: Steamed Whole Fish
steps: Rinse the fish, pat dry and top with shredded ginger.
Steam over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes.
Pour off the liquid from the plate, add the shredded spring onion, then drizzle with hot oil and the soy sauce.

dishes.name: Poached Prawns
steps: Bring water to the boil with the sliced ginger.
Add the prawns and poach until they turn red and curl.
Drain and plate, with the soy sauce on the side for dipping.

dishes.name: Steamed Scallops with Garlic and Glass Noodles
steps: Soak the glass noodles until soft and lay them on the scallops.
Fry the minced garlic in the oil until fragrant and spoon it on top.
Steam over high heat for 6 minutes, then drizzle with light soy sauce.

dishes.name: Scrambled Eggs with Shrimp
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt.
Stir-fry the shrimp until they change colour, then set aside.
Pour in the egg; when half set, add the shrimp and chopped spring onion and fold together.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Squid with Celery
steps: Score the squid and blanch briefly.
Cut the celery into sections.
Fry the ginger and garlic until fragrant, then add the celery and squid and stir-fry well.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Clams with Black Bean and Pepper
steps: Soak the clams in water to purge the sand.
Fry the fermented black beans, garlic and green pepper until fragrant.
Add the clams and stir-fry until they open.

dishes.name: Steamed Fish Fillet with Ginger and Spring Onion
steps: Pat the fish fillet dry and lay on a plate.
Top with shredded ginger and steam for 6 minutes.
Add chopped spring onion and drizzle with light soy sauce.

dishes.name: Blanched Choy Sum
steps: Bring water to the boil and add a little oil.
Blanch the choy sum for 2 minutes until tender.
Plate, with the oyster sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Broccoli with Garlic
steps: Cut the broccoli into small florets.
Fry the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the broccoli with a splash of water and stir-fry until cooked, then season with salt.

dishes.name: Chinese Spinach in Stock
steps: Fry the garlic until golden.
Bring the stock to the boil with the century egg and garlic.
Add the Chinese spinach and cook for 2 minutes.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Spinach with Garlic
steps: Wash the spinach and cut into sections.
Fry the minced garlic until fragrant.
Stir-fry the spinach over high heat until wilted, then season with salt.

dishes.name: Steamed Stuffed Tofu
steps: Scoop a small hollow in the centre of each tofu piece.
Fill with the dace fish paste.
Steam for 10 minutes, sprinkle with chopped spring onion and drizzle with light soy sauce.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Snow Peas
steps: String the snow peas.
Fry the garlic until fragrant.
Stir-fry over high heat for 2 minutes, then season with salt.

dishes.name: Blanched Lettuce
steps: Bring water to the boil and add the oil.
Blanch the lettuce for 30 seconds.
Plate, with the oyster sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Steamed Aubergine
steps: Cut the aubergines into strips.
Steam over high heat for 10 minutes.
Top with minced garlic, then drizzle with hot oil and light soy sauce.

dishes.name: Stir-fried Cabbage
steps: Tear the cabbage into small pieces.
Fry the garlic until fragrant.
Stir-fry over high heat until softened, then season with salt.

dishes.name: Tomato and Tofu Soup
steps: Cut the tomatoes into chunks and stir-fry until juicy.
Add the water, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu and cook for 5 minutes, then add salt and chopped spring onion.

dishes.name: Winter Melon and Lean Pork Soup
steps: Blanch the lean pork.
Cut the winter melon into chunks, skin on.
Simmer all the ingredients for 50 minutes, then add salt.

dishes.name: Sweetcorn, Carrot and Pork Bone Soup
steps: Blanch the pork bones.
Cut the sweetcorn and carrots into sections.
Bring all the ingredients to the boil over high heat, then simmer on low for 80 minutes and add salt.

dishes.name: Spinach, Tofu and Fish Fillet Soup
steps: Bring the water to the boil with the ginger.
Add the tofu and fish fillet and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the spinach, bring back to the boil and add salt.

dishes.name: Seaweed and Egg Drop Soup
steps: Bring the water to the boil and add the seaweed.
Slowly pour in the beaten egg to form ribbons.
Add salt and chopped spring onion.

dishes.name: Hairy Gourd and Lean Pork Soup
steps: Blanch the lean pork.
Peel the hairy gourd and cut into chunks.
Simmer all the ingredients for 50 minutes, then add salt.
